newsitem.title: USA: Basin Electric 550 MW Wyo. unit up after repairs.
newsitem.headline: Basin Electric 550 MW Wyo. unit up after repairs.

text.p: Basin Electric Power Cooperative's 550 megawatt (MW) Laramie River Station (LRS) coal-fired unit 3 resumed operation late Thursday following repairs to the unit's boiler tubes, the utility said Friday.
"Unit 3 came up as of last night," said spokesman Stan Stelter. "Everything is running," he added, referring to the facility's two other 550 MW units.
LRS's unit 3 was taken off line Wednesday after briefly returning to service the same day. LRS 3, in Wheatland, WYo., was originally shut last Saturday for boiler tube problems.
Basin Electric, headquartered in Bismarck. N.D., is the operator of LRS and majority owner with a 42.27 percent stake. Five other Midwest public utilities co-own the plant.
